design.data: Reused 32-text confirmation set; exploratory mechanistic audit, not fresh holdout
design.policy: frozen 128D 2%-active policies from prior campaign; three training seeds, same anatomy
design.primary: post-initial-cue accuracy at ticks1..11 and13..23 on clean one-shot episodes
design.settings: All grids specified before running this study; no best-configuration selection
design.zero_input: uniform policy; argmax ties select class0, yielding 25% on balanced labels
design.trace: host preprocessing only, no trained recurrence
design.hold_detection: any nonzero input; background refreshes memory too, no oracle event gating
design.cue_off: actual schedule pulse mask; continuous schedule has no cue-off probes
design.decay_boundary: native hidden-max normalization removes nonzero scalar decay; only direction, exact zero, host cutoff or numerical underflow changes the effective signal
design.cutoff: fixed emitted-state norm .05; uncalibrated absolute amplitude gate
